blurb: Good Times Adventure Tours offers guided snowmobile tours and dog sled tours near Breckenridge, Colorado. Guests can ride brand new Ski Doo snowmobiles on an extensive trail system or mush a team of Siberian Huskies through the forest. The lodge is located a few miles from downtown Breckenridge and is accessible from major resorts in the central Rockies.
